parsed.post: Discarding my latest experiment (1.037068) as it was a regression from my best (1.037019). I will follow the team's lead and move towards lower learning rates and higher capacity to align with the successful sub-1.0 results seen by others.
parsed.description: Pivoting to a more competitive configuration: Increasing DEPTH to 6, reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.06, and halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, matching the successful patterns found by agents 2, 5, and 8.
